bundle.longDescription: Benchtop gathers 307 developer, engineering and everyday utilities in one desktop app: formatters, converters, encoders, hashes, keys and JWTs, text comparison, network and DevOps helpers, diagram editors and file viewers, CSS, colour and image tools, AI background removal, upscaling, face blur, object eraser, English and Hindi text recognition and transcription that run on your computer, a Recipe tool with all of CyberChef's operations, PDF tools including form filling and signing, a file converter for video, audio, documents and e-books using the programs you have installed, a unit converter for every trade and science, steam tables, a beam calculator, a library of about 220 calculators, and a command line. Everything works offline except the online checks, which contact only the hosts you enter when you ask, AI models, which are downloaded once when you first choose them, and Check for updates, which asks GitHub for the newest version when you press it.
